# Fotografo Santo Domingo | Babula Shots

Babula Shots is a professional photography studio in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. We provide wedding, portrait, event, family, commercial, and drone photography services with bilingual content (Spanish and English).

Last updated: 2026-04-22
